<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="vi"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no"><title>Hứng vật rơi</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#12263a;color:#fff;font:16px system-ui,sans-serif;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
#h{position:fixed;top:8px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-weight:700;pointer-events:none}
#m{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#12263aee;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;padding:10px;text-align:center}
#g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:6px;width:min(90vw,340px)}
button{background:#fbbf24;color:#2a1c00;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font:inherit;font-weight:700}button:disabled{background:#2b4560;color:#7f9bb8}
</style><canvas id="c"></canvas><div id="h"></div><div id="m"></div><script>
const C=c.getContext('2d'),N=20,K='mg_catch',T='🧺 Hứng vật rơi',hint=matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches?'Kéo ngón tay để di chuyển giỏ, hứng 🍎⭐ và tránh 💣':'← → hoặc di chuột để di chuyển giỏ, hứng 🍎⭐ và tránh 💣';
let W,H,U,lv=1,run=0,best=1,lt=0,px=0;try{best=+localStorage[K]||1}catch(e){}
function rs(){W=c.width=innerWidth;H=c.height=innerHeight;U=Math.min(W,H*.8)*.09}onresize=rs;rs();
function menu(){run=0;m.style.display='flex';m.innerHTML=`<h2>${T}</h2><p>Chọn màn (${best}/${N})</p><div id="g"></div><p style="opacity:.7;max-width:90vw">${hint}</p>`;for(let i=1;i<=N;i++){const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=i;b.disabled=i>best;b.onclick=()=>go(i);g.append(b)}}
function end(w){if(!run)return;run=0;if(w&&lv>=best&&best<N){best=lv+1;try{localStorage[K]=best}catch(e){}}m.style.display='flex';m.innerHTML=`<h2>${w?'🎉 Qua màn '+lv:'💥 Thua rồi'}</h2><button id="ba">${w&&lv<N?'Màn tiếp':'Chơi lại'}</button><button id="bm">Chọn màn</button>`;ba.onclick=()=>go(w&&lv<N?lv+1:lv);bm.onclick=menu}
function go(l){lv=l;m.style.display='none';rs();init();run=1;lt=performance.now()}
function loop(t){const d=Math.min((t-lt)/1000,.05);lt=t;if(run){upd(d);draw()}requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
let O,lf,sc,goal,tm,bw,ks={};
function init(){O=[];lf=5;sc=0;goal=8+lv*2;tm=0;px=W/2;bw=U*Math.max(2.8-lv*.06,1.5)}
function upd(d){if(ks.ArrowLeft)px-=W*.9*d;if(ks.ArrowRight)px+=W*.9*d;px=Math.max(bw/2,Math.min(W-bw/2,px));
tm-=d;if(tm<=0){tm=Math.max(.9-lv*.03,.35)*(.7+Math.random()*.6);const b=Math.random()<Math.min(.1+lv*.02,.45);O.push({x:U+Math.random()*(W-2*U),y:-U,b,e:b?'💣':Math.random()<.5?'🍎':'⭐'})}
const by=H-U*1.3;
O.forEach(o=>{o.y+=H*(.25+lv*.02)*d;if(Math.abs(o.x-px)<bw/2&&Math.abs(o.y-by)<U*.6){o.s=1;o.b?lf--:sc++}else if(o.y>H+U){o.s=1;if(!o.b)lf--}});
O=O.filter(o=>!o.s);if(lf<=0)end(0);else if(sc>=goal)end(1)}
function draw(){C.clearRect(0,0,W,H);C.font=U+'px serif';C.textAlign='center';C.textBaseline='middle';O.forEach(o=>C.fillText(o.e,o.x,o.y));
C.fillText('🧺',px,H-U*1.3);C.fillStyle='#fbbf24';C.fillRect(px-bw/2,H-U*.95,bw,6);h.textContent=`Màn ${lv} · ✅ ${sc}/${goal} · ❤️ ${lf}`}
onkeydown=e=>{ks[e.key]=1;if(e.key.startsWith('Arrow'))e.preventDefault()};onkeyup=e=>ks[e.key]=0;
c.onpointermove=e=>{if(run)px=e.clientX};c.onpointerdown=e=>{px=e.clientX};
menu();requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
